_comment: Doors, windows, and add-ons. 'requires' rules are checked against the live design and the grayed-out reason shown to the customer is GENERATED from the rule — you do not write the message. 'excludes' MUST be mutual (if A excludes B, B excludes A) or behavior depends on click order; the validator enforces it. Omit 'styles' to offer an option on every style. Sizes are feet: a 6'8" door is 6.667. Doors carry an 'operation': 'swing' (walk-in, finished from the Doors colors), 'rollup' (a steel curtain, which takes the garage door color) or 'sectional' (a garage door, which takes the garage door color and style).

options.name: 36" Single Door
options.blurb: Standard walk-in door.

options.name: 5' Double Door
options.blurb: Gets a mower through.

options.name: 6' Double Door
options.blurb: Gets a tractor through.

options.name: 8' × 7' Garage Door
options.blurb: Steel sectional door on a manual track, for a narrower front. Needs 8ft walls.

options.name: 9' × 7' Garage Door
options.blurb: Steel sectional door on a manual track. Fits one car. Needs 8ft walls.

options.name: 16' × 7' Garage Door
options.blurb: Double-wide sectional door. Two cars side by side.

options.name: 8' Power Garage Door
options.blurb: Insulated sectional door with an opener and two remotes. Needs 8ft walls and electrical.

options.name: 8' Roll-Up Door
options.blurb: Steel roll-up curtain on a manual drum. Needs 8ft walls for the drum to clear.

options.name: Garage Door Opener
options.blurb: Belt-drive opener for one garage door, with two remotes and a wall keypad. Runs off your electrical.

options.name: 24" × 36" Window
options.blurb: Screened, opens.
options._sillNote: Sill + height + trim has to clear the eave. A 7ft wall gives you 6.75ft of budget (3in of siding is kept above the trim), so 3.0 + 3 + 0.3 = 6.3 fits. The obvious-looking 3.5 does not — it comes to 6.8 and the window then won't go on ANY 7ft wall, on any size.

options.name: 30" × 40" Window
options.blurb: Screened, opens. More light.

options.name: 48" Transom
options.blurb: High fixed light. Sits above the header, so it needs 8ft walls.

options.name: Loft Storage Kit
options.blurb: Decked loft in the gambrel overhead. Barn roofs only — nothing else has the headroom.

options.name: Attic Storage Trusses
options.blurb: Storage trusses and a decked attic over the bays. The steep roof is what makes the room for it.

options.name: Basic Electrical
options.blurb: Two outlets and one LED shop light on a switch, fed from a 25ft cord inlet outside. Plug it into the house and go.

options.name: Full Electrical Package
options.blurb: 60A sub-panel, six outlets, four LED shop lights, an outdoor GFCI outlet and lights at the main door. Ready for an electrician to land a feed.

options.name: Insulation
options.blurb: R-13 batts between the studs and R-19 between the rafters, cut around every box and split around every wire.

options.name: OSB Wall Lining
options.blurb: 7/16in OSB screwed to every stud. Hang a shelf or a tool anywhere on the wall.

options.name: Drywall
options.blurb: 1/2in drywall hung and screwed on every wall. Seams and screws show, ready for tape and paint.

options.name: Finished & Painted Walls
options.blurb: Drywall hung, taped, mudded, sanded and painted in the color you pick. Pair it with insulation.

options.name: Workbench
options.blurb: 8ft bench, full depth.

options.name: Shelving Kit
options.blurb: Three tiers, one wall.

options.name: Wooden Ramp
options.blurb: Sized to your door, for getting a mower in. Sheds only — a garage sits on its slab.

options.name: Ridge Vent
options.blurb: Continuous vent along the peak.

options.name: Cupola
options.blurb: Sits on the peak. Takes the ridge, so it can’t share with a ridge vent.

options.name: Treated Floor Upgrade
options.blurb: Pressure-treated joists and decking.

options.name: Heavy-Duty Floor
options.blurb: 2×8 joists at 12in centers and 3/4in decking, rated for a car. Skip it if you’re building on a slab.

options.name: Ground Anchor Kit
options.blurb: Auger anchors. Some townships require them.
